translations.translatedText: # Tuesday 30.11.2021 (radio)
Government corona talks. The prime minister works remotely. Inflation in the euro area. A fire at a ski wax factory. Credit card thieves. Weather forecast.
## Government corona talks
![Krista Kiuru.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5808,h_3267,x_0,y_325/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-88631161a63289dd52c/1638281918)
Open image viewer
Minister of Family and Basic Services Krista Kiuru. Photo: Benjamin Suomela / Yle

The government held talks on Tuesday about the corona situation. The government has discussed what must be done in Finland so that the corona situation improves. The government is especially worried about the new Omicron variant of the corona virus.
Minister of Family and Basic Services Krista Kiuru said in the afternoon that the government wants to act quickly. The government has also discussed increasing the use of the corona pass.
On Tuesday 900 new corona infections were reported.
## Sanna Marin works remotely

![Prime Minister Sanna Marin being interviewed for Yle's TV news in the State Room of Parliament.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5472,h_3078,x_0,y_282/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-869612617019875530f/1634736595)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin. Photo: Toni Määttä / Yle
Prime Minister Sanna Marin has started working remotely. The reason is that Marin has mild flu symptoms.
For now she works from the official residence in Kesäranta. Marin will also have a corona test.
Prime Minister Marin took part in the government talks on Tuesday by remote connection.
## Inflation

![On the price board in the yard of a Teboil station, fuel prices are shown. The price of a litre of 98-octane petrol is just over two euros.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6240,h_3510,x_0,y_650/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-881132619632a738f43/1637234052)
Open image viewer
For example, the price of petrol has risen a lot. Photo: Pyry Sarkiola / Yle
Inflation, that is the rise in prices, has speeded up a lot in the euro area.
The EU's statistics office says that consumer prices rose by almost 5 per cent in the euro area in November. Consumer prices have risen more than in 20 years.
A major reason is the price of energy. Energy has become much more expensive in many countries.
## Ski wax factory fire
![Rescuers putting out a fire in a snowy yard.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4028,h_2268,x_0,y_661/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-88627961a6281e62185/1638279341)
Open image viewer
The ski factory suffered big damage. Photo: Ari Tauslahti / Yle
On Tuesday afternoon a big fire broke out at a ski wax factory in Joensuu. At least 1 person was seriously injured in the fire. In addition, 2 people were slightly injured.
All the workers of the ski wax factory got out of the burning factory. The factory suffered big damage in the fire.
It is not yet known where the fire at the ski wax factory in Joensuu started.
## Credit card thieves
![A person paying for shopping at a card terminal.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6000,h_3375,x_0,y_309/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-7892686060491621bf5/1616924014)
Open image viewer
Thieves have been spying on people's PIN codes at the till. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle
The police warn about thieves who spy on the PIN codes of payment cards.
The thieves watch people's PIN codes at the shop till, when a person keys in the PIN code. After that a credit card has been stolen from the person, whose PIN code the criminal has seen.
The police say that such cases have happened in different parts of Finland. The police say that the PIN code of a payment card must be keyed in so that other people cannot see the PIN code.
## Weather
![Wednesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12210927)
Open image viewer
It is frosty across the whole of Finland.

On Wednesday it is dry in the south and west, that is, it does not rain. The sun also shines in many places. In the east and north it snows. The temperature is between -5 and -15 degrees, and it is colder in Northern Lapland.
